title: Condition for a vertical tangent
text: A vertical tangent occurs where $$\frac{dx}{dt}=0$$ and $$\frac{dy}{dt}$$ is not $$0$$.

title: Solve
text: $$\frac{dx}{dt}=2cos\left(2t\right)=0$$ when $$2t$$ is an odd multiple of $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$, that is, $$t=\frac{\pi}{4}$$, $$\frac{3\pi}{4}$$, $$\frac{5\pi}{4}$$, $$\frac{7\pi}{4}$$. At these values cos(t) is not $$0$$, so $$\frac{dy}{dt}$$ is not $$0$$.
